_note: Atlas MCP tool specs (2026-10-20 extension pack). Same shape as core.mjs LEGACY_TOOLS entries. Resolvers read atlas/merged/{nodes,edges,streams}.json via build-notes.md ingestion.

tools.description: A concept traced through time: the Atlas thread for an idea (e.g. emptiness, the imaginal, tikkun) — oldest holders first, with the streams it travels and the talks/texts attached at each stop.

concept.description: concept id or label, e.g. c-emptiness or emptiness

tools.name: get_concept_thread
tools.resolver: concept node -> holders (edges into node, conf-sorted) -> per-holder: stream, time label, attached texts/talks (wiser text/clip links where mapped); oldest first
tools.title: Concept thread

tools.description: The shortest documented path between any two Atlas nodes (person, tradition, concept, text) across dharma, academic, influence, textual and geographic edges. Every hop carries its confidence and basis; contested hops are flagged, never smoothed.
tools.name: find_path
tools.resolver: BFS over merged edges filtered by lineage class; edge rel classes: dharma (teacher_of/studied_with/ordained_by/dharma_heir_of), academic (academic_supervisor_of/edited/translated), influence (influenced/commented_on/expounds/parallels), textual (lineage_of/founded/member_of/abbot_of/teacher_at), geographic (sister_of/teacher_at-place). Return hops with conf+basis+contested.
tools.title: Path between nodes
